text: {"lessons":["My patience in the first three periods avoided unnecessary trading; I should keep checking decisions against a clear plan rather than trade just because prices move.","Buying Stock C after a down month was not enough of a reason by itself; I should assess its fundamentals, risks, and role in a diversified portfolio before adding.","Selling half of Stock C at a gain felt rewarding, but I should avoid letting that satisfaction—or the pain of realizing losses—replace a consistent, forward-looking reason to sell or hold."]}
